title: The Political meeting in the city
subtitle: 国家公民 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 国家公民（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·国家与公民）
meta: 主题语境：国家公民（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·国家与公民）　|　核心词汇：political　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 political 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1981 the planner wrote of ① a political meeting in the city in the report, and everybody in the district said at once that it was ② so political that nobody in the district would go near it. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the planner, who never explained anything, had done it without complaint and gone home; it was the political ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the political meeting in the city that anybody there had ever seen, or so the report for March 1975 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too political to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the citizen who had come to help; the political ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the plan at the far square, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a political life of the country, and said that no citizen in his right mind would call it ⑥ as political as the life of the country they had once had in the old district. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was political or not, and he said so.

By 1988 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the report. What the line asked for was ⑦ something political, and nothing besides. The citizen from the next district called the whole plan ⑧ quite political; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the report kept the names of the political ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1991, with great care, she wrote of another political meeting in the city in the same report, and the work, which took two years, seemed ⑨ no less political than anybody had expected. ⑩ The political life of the country that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1993, was the one she could never quite name; the political ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 政治（前置定语 a political meeting in the city：1981 年规划员在规划报告里记下的那件政治的集会）
B. adj. 政治／政界（两处加强说法：so political that … 与 no less political than …）
C. adj. 政治／政界（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 政治（表语 too political to do：母亲觉得它太政治，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 政界（前置定语 a political life of the country：叔叔把整件事称作一桩政界的政治生活）
F. adj. 政界（同级比较 as political as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩国家的政治生活相比）
G. adj. 政界（后置定语 something political：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 政界（受程度副词修饰 quite political：那位市民的评价）

items.q: a political meeting in the city
the political meeting in the city that
a political life of the country
The political life of the country that

answers.why: political 意为“政治”，1981 年规划员在规划报告里记下的是“一件政治的集会”，此处作前置定语 a political meeting in the city。
political 意为“政治”，此处用 so political that 结构，说它政治到街区里没人敢靠近。
political 意为“政治”，规划报告上 三月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的政治城里的政治集会，等于最高级的说法。
political 意为“政治”，母亲认为这件东西“太政治了，谁也用不上”，too political to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
political 意为“政界”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩政界的政治生活”，此处作前置定语 a political life of the country。
political 意为“政界”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩国家的政治生活一样政界”，同级比较用 as political as。
political 意为“政界”，规划报告上那半行字要的是“政界的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something political。
political 意为“政界”，邻街区来的那位市民认为这套计划“相当政界”，quite 修饰原级 political。
political 意为“政界”，no less political than 表示“其政界不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之政界不亚于任何人的预料。
political 意为“政界”，母亲 1993 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的政界政治生活”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1981 年，规划员在规划报告里记下了一件政治的集会。（a political meeting in the city）
它政治到街区里没有一个人敢靠近。（so political that …）
母亲觉得它太政治，谁也用不上。（too political to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩政界的政治生活。（a political life of the country）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩国家的政治生活一样政界。（as political as …）
到了 1988 年，规划报告上只剩半行字：要的是一件政界的东西。（something political）
answers: In 1981 the planner wrote of a political meeting in the city in the report.
It was so political that nobody in the district would go near it.
My mother thought it too political to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a political life of the country.
He said nobody would call it as political as the life of the country they had once had.
By 1988 the report asked for nothing but something political.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 political 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1981 the planner wrote of a political meeting in the city in the report, and nobody forgot it.
It was the political meeting in the city that anybody there had ever seen, or so the report says.
My mother thought it too political to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a political life of the country, and nobody argued with him.
The citizen from the next district called the plan quite political, and everybody laughed.
The political ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
